from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Response
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
import ctypes
import struct
import base64
import json
from typing import Optional

app = FastAPI()

# Native memory pool for high-performance session caching
class NativeSessionPool:
    """Uses ctypes malloc/free for zero-copy session deserialization"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self._allocations = {}  # ptr -> size
        self._libc = ctypes.CDLL("libc.so.6")
        self._libc.malloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self._libc.free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self._libc.free.restype = None
        self._libc.memcpy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
    
    def allocate(self, data: bytes) -> int:
        size = len(data)
        ptr = self._libc.malloc(size)
        if not ptr:
            raise MemoryError("malloc failed")
        self._libc.memcpy(ptr, data, size)
        self._allocations[ptr] = size
        return ptr
    
    def deallocate(self, ptr: int):
        """Free a previously allocated buffer"""
        if ptr in self._allocations:
            self._libc.free(ctypes.c_void_p(ptr))
            del self._allocations[ptr]
    
    def force_release(self, ptr: int):
        """Emergency release - skips tracking check for crash recovery"""
        self._libc.free(ctypes.c_void_p(ptr))
        # Note: does NOT remove from _allocations dict
        # This is intentional for post-mortem debugging

pool = NativeSessionPool()
active_sessions = {}  # session_id -> ptr

@app.post("/session/create")
async def create_session(request: Request):
    body = await request.body()
    content_type = request.headers.get("content-type", "")
    
    if "application/x-session-binary" in content_type:
        # Binary session format: base64 encoded payload
        session_data = base64.b64decode(body)
    else:
        data = json.loads(body)
        session_data = json.dumps(data.get("session_state", {})).encode()
    
    ptr = pool.allocate(session_data)
    session_id = data.get("session_id", str(ptr)) if "application/x-session-binary" not in content_type else str(ptr)
    active_sessions[session_id] = ptr
    return {"session_id": session_id, "allocated": True}

@app.post("/session/invalidate")
async def invalidate_session(request: Request):
    body = await request.json()
    session_id = body.get("session_id")
    emergency = body.get("emergency_purge", False)
    
    if session_id not in active_sessions:
        return JSONResponse(status_code=404, content={"error": "session not found"})
    
    ptr = active_sessions[session_id]
    
    if emergency:
        # Emergency purge path - used during incident response
        pool.force_release(ptr)
        # BUG: force_release doesn't remove from _allocations
        # so a subsequent normal deallocate will double-free
    else:
        pool.deallocate(ptr)
    
    del active_sessions[session_id]
    return {"invalidated": True}

@app.post("/session/cleanup")
async def cleanup_stale():
    """Periodic cleanup - frees any tracked allocations not in active sessions"""
    active_ptrs = set(active_sessions.values())
    stale = [ptr for ptr in pool._allocations if ptr not in active_ptrs]
    for ptr in stale:
        pool.deallocate(ptr)  # Double-free if force_release was called earlier
    return {"cleaned": len(stale)}

@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "active_sessions": len(active_sessions), "tracked_allocs": len(pool._allocations)}
